runner.scope: Reviewed nonebot-plugin-alconna and nonebot-plugin-uninfo commits were installed from detached worktrees and invoked only through curator-authored probes.
runner.dependency_policy: Python and direct dependency versions were pinned from each target commit's PDM lockfile.
runner.credential_policy: GitHub and model API token environment variables were removed from every probe process.
runner.limitations: The process boundary is not container-grade isolation; adapter APIs were stubbed and no external platform was contacted.

results.buggy_observation: The Discord CustomEmojiSegment converted to universal Emoji with id 123456 and no CDN URL.
results.fixed_observation: The identical segment converted to universal Image with https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/123456.png.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.11, nonebot2 2.3.3, nonebot-adapter-discord 0.1.8, PDM-lock dependency pins

results.buggy_observation: Converting the Telegram video segment with data['file'] raised KeyError: 'file_id'.
results.fixed_observation: The identical segment converted to Video and preserved telegram-file-id.
results.environment: Windows, CPython 3.12, nonebot2 2.4.0, nonebot-adapter-telegram 0.1.0b19, PDM-lock dependency pins

results.buggy_observation: A QQ DirectMessageCreateEvent produced CHANNEL_TEXT and is_private false, identical to the public guild control.
results.fixed_observation: The direct event produced PRIVATE and is_private true while the public guild control remained CHANNEL_TEXT.

results.buggy_observation: The bot-authored Satori direct event fell back to scene id bot instead of peer-channel; the public channel control used peer-channel.
results.fixed_observation: The same direct event preserved peer-channel as the private scene id and the public channel control remained CHANNEL_TEXT.

results.buggy_observation: An existing Windows avatar path was embedded after the api.telegram.org/file/bot token prefix instead of becoming a file URI.
results.fixed_observation: The existing path became file:///C:/... while a remote/avatar.jpg control still produced the Telegram cloud URL.
